control_profile: Three-day residual-price confirmation of broad settled-funding pools, causal 28-day BTC state budgets, seven-day overlapping cohorts, volatility scaling, drawdown brakes, position stops and turnover throttling.
falsifier: A symmetric entry threshold of -0.25 fails to make both long-low-funding and short-high-funding roles positive, or apparent improvement is narrow, costly, regime-dependent or fold-concentrated.
formation_horizon: robust seven-day and twenty-eight-day settled funding with a twenty-eight-day BTC state, twenty-one-bar residual scale and nine-bar price confirmation at z -0.25
hypothesis: Funding carry is viable only after adverse price continuation has stopped: low-funding longs require supportive residual trend and high-funding shorts require nonpositive residual trend before entry, without changing the carry sign.
rebalance_horizon: one daily cohort averaged across seven overlapping daily vintages
